description: Skip the items your own recent runs rejected. A listing (an RSS or Atom document) is parsed, but first `workflow.history` reads the urls that this workflow's runs of the last 24 hours rejected (their output was {status: check_failed, url}); they go into feed.parse's exclude_urls, so a rejected article is not picked and rewritten again on the next run. The workflow returns the first remaining item as {status: picked, url}; a real workflow would write and check a summary there and return {status: check_failed, reason, url} when `text.check` refuses it. With nothing left the run ends `skipped`. It needs no agent: it uses platform tools only.

spec.name: Skip recently rejected items
spec.description: Parse a feed without the items this workflow's own recent runs rejected (workflow.history), return the first remaining item, or end skipped when there is none.

feed.description: The RSS or Atom document to read.
